interface.signature: s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int -> int

preconditions.description: The length of string s1 must be between 1 and 100 characters.
The length of string s2 must be between 1 and 100 characters.
The integer n1 must be between 0 and 1,000,000.
The integer n2 must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum integer M such that [S2,M] can be obtained from S1.
